## Changes

### New
- Slide a finger along the nav bar to switch tabs, or along the rail on wide screens. Tab bars and segmented controls work the same way. The tab under your finger opens when you let go.
- Change source: Open shows a loader until the new source is ready, instead of seeming to do nothing on a slow connection.

### Fixes
- Covers that failed to load while offline now load on a pull to refresh, without restarting the app.
